[[File:Padmefull4Travel.jpg|thumb|Queen Amidala's Traveling Gown.]]
'''Chersilk''' was a fabric favored by the monarchy of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] Traveling Gown was made of the material, as was [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana's]] mourning robe. It came in shades such as mauve and black.<ref name="Gowns">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
